title: Appeals and Grievances Casebook: Inpatient Cost Share on Continued-Stay Days at Issue
content:
Casebook, Appeals and Grievances: inpatient cost share on the days at issue

Scope: an Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration taken on a denied continued-stay request for an inpatient mental health stay.

Rule: The cost share on the days at issue is figured by the tier's inpatient basis for a facility of that network status: under a percentage-of-allowed basis it is the cost-share percentage of the amount it is figured on; under a lesser-of basis it is the smaller of the daily inpatient charge for each day and the cost-share percentage of the amount it is figured on; under a per-admission basis it is the tier's admission copayment; under any other basis it is the daily inpatient charge for each day, never less than the tier's minimum inpatient charge; it is rounded to the cent.

The basis read is the tier's network inpatient basis for a facility recorded as network and its non-network inpatient basis for a facility recorded as non-network; the daily inpatient charge is likewise the tier's network or non-network daily inpatient charge by that status. The minimum inpatient charge is the tier's minimum inpatient charge and the admission copayment is the tier's inpatient admission copayment — the minimum charge and the admission copayment shown in the tier's network inpatient schedule, whatever the facility's status — as set in the TRICARE Select schedule of the tier the stay is billed under. The days are the days at issue.

Hypothetical inputs: 5 days; amount the cost share is figured on 4,250.00; cost-share percentage 20; daily inpatient charge 250.00; minimum inpatient charge 25.00; admission copayment 200.00.

| Basis | Cost share |
|---|---|
| percentage of the allowed amount | 20 percent of 4,250.00, which is 850.00 |
| lesser of a daily charge and a percentage | the smaller of 1,250.00 (250.00 for each of 5 days) and 850.00, which is 850.00 |
| per-admission copayment | 200.00 |
| daily charge with a minimum | 1,250.00 (not below 25.00) |

On the minimum: with 1 day and a daily charge of 20.00, the daily charge for each day comes to 20.00, below the 25.00 minimum, so the cost share is 25.00.
